integrity: The finite Jacobi weight identity and the variational Airy limit are stated with explicit hypotheses. Numerical evidence is separated from mathematical proof. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real \(\alpha>-1\). No uniform alpha limit, full higher-eigenvalue expansion, or independent verification claimed. Airy asymptotics follow from analytic compactness and variational bounds; finite checker is supplementary.
title: The Airy boundary layer for polynomial compressions of the weighted Bergman shift
